messages:
support_engineer: Hey team — escalating a customer-reported streaming issue. They get a partial SSE payload then the connection stalls and the client reconnects in a tight loop. Happening via Cloudflare -> ALB -> app. trace_id=tx-9a7c.

customer_jim: Repro steps i gave them: curl -v -N \"https://api.redwood-prod.example/v1/live?model=test-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\". They see an initial chunk (~1.2KB) then nothing for ~40-50s, then client reconnects and receives truncated content. Happens on our hosted plan and on Dedicated customer when routed through their ALB.

ingress_infra: Thanks. Can you paste ALB access log for that timeframe and client-side chrome/net logs? Also which ALB type (classic/ALB/NLB)?

support_engineer: ALB (application). Pasted snippet from ALB access log: 
  2026-03-15T21:12:43.123Z app/redwood-alb 10.0.0.1:443 10.0.1.23:51012 200 200 0.001 50.234 0.000 0.000 \"GET https://api.../v1/live HTTP/1.1\" \"curl/7.79.1\" ALB-RequestId=tx-9a7c

network_ops: That latency field (50.234) looks like backend processing? Can you also capture tcpdump on the node for a repro and check for FIN/PSH/ACKs?

customer_jim: I attached client-side HAR — shows event-stream chunks stop arriving after the initial data and browser tries reconnecting after 61s.

eng-runtime: Quick theory: ALB has an idle timeout default 60s. If our app isn't sending any bytes (or if an intermediate proxy buffers the chunk), the ALB will close. Also Cloudflare can buffer/chunk responses depending on settings. Are we sending periodic keepalive/heartbeat bytes?

support_engineer: Right now our SSE handler flushes on event boundaries, but long gaps between events can be common. No explicit heartbeat every X seconds.

ingress_infra: Two likely culprits: 1) upstream (app) not flushing and nginx/Envoy/nginx ingress is buffering; 2) Cloudflare or ALB is closing idle connections. For ALB, bump idle timeout to 120s for the target group as a test. For Cloudflare, ensure 'Origin Response Buffering' is disabled / use Page Rule to bypass caching for this path.

eng-runtime: Add repro notes: run this loop locally to simulate server behavior: 
```
for i in 1..3
  puts "data: chunk #{i}\n\n"
  STDOUT.flush
  sleep 45
end
```
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \"https://.../v1/live\"

This will show the long idle gap. If a proxy buffers until connection close, you'll see nothing client-side until connection close.

network_ops: Also watch for HTTP/2 middleboxes. ALB terminates HTTP/2 and speaks HTTP/1.1 to backend. Cloudflare may do HTTP/2 muxing — can introduce buffering. Try forcing http/1.1 from client to rule out h2-specific buffering: `curl --http1.1 -v -N ...`

support_engineer: We ran `curl --http1.1` against a repro host and saw the same pattern. But when we add a server-side heartbeat every 15s (send a single `:\n` or a comment) the connection stays healthy.

customer_jim: So adding heartbeats fixes it for them too. They pushed a temporary patch to emit `: keepalive\n\n` every 15s and the reconnects stopped.

ingress_infra: Good diagnostic. Action items:
- ingress_infra: test bumping ALB idle timeout to 120s for a week and monitor.
- network_ops: open ticket with Cloudflare to check for any response buffering rules on streaming endpoints and test bypass.
- eng-runtime: implement server-side optional keepalive/heartbeat config and a small sample in docs.

support_engineer: Filed CF ticket (#CF-8342) and ALB change request (#ALB-4012). Customer happy with heartbeat workaround for now. Leaving oncall and eng to own long-term fix.

oncall_bot: Incident created: #INC-3942 (SSE partial output + reconnects via CF+ALB). Assigned to eng-runtime, ingress_infra.

eng-runtime: We'll add a small config flag `STREAM_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS` with default 0 (off) and enable for hosted endpoints after validation. Plan to ship a PR with tests next week.

network_ops: Also note: if customers are fronting with NLB (TCP passthrough) the issue is usually less likely because NLB won't terminate or buffer HTTP. Recommend Dedicated customers wanting low-latency streaming use NLB or pass-through proxies.

support_engineer: Closing the loop here — customer wants a changelog entry and a docs note with recommended settings (ALB idle timeout >= 120s or add heartbeat, Cloudflare: disable buffering for SSE path). I'll draft docs and link PRs. :thumbsup:
